oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Open Source at Harvard
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Durbin, Philip
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: The tabular file contains information on known Harvard repositories on GitHub, such as the number of stars, programming language, day last updated, number of open issues, size, number of forks, repository URL, create date, and description. Each repository has a corresponding JSON file (see primary-data.zip) that was retrieved using the GitHub API with code and a list of repositories available from https://github.com/IQSS/open-source-at-harvard.
